desc.0: Press <IconNormal /> to activate:
desc.1: Perform up to four strikes forward, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.

desc.0: Press <IconNormal /> while in the Crimson Inscription state to activate:
desc.1: Use the Blood Axe to perform up to three slashes forward, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: When the second attack is launched, Claret leaps backward and throws the Blood Axe. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered during the retreat.
desc.3: When the third attack is launched, Claret performs a series of slashes before leaping up and performing a downward smash. During the repeated slashes, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Repeatedly press or hold <IconNormal /> to extend the duration of the repeated slashes. Stop pressing or release <IconNormal /> to make Claret immediately leap up and perform a downward smash. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered while leaping. After successfully triggering a Perfect Dodge, press or hold <IconNormal /> to follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
desc.4: Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.

BasicAttackBloodbloomOathSubduingAxe.name: Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe

desc.0: While in the Crimson Inscription state, after launching [Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron] or [Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault] and successfully triggering [Maim], press or hold <IconNormal /> to activate:
desc.1: Use the Blood Axe to spin and leap into the air, then slam down and slash the target enemy, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>. A Perfect Dodge can be triggered while leaping.
desc.2: After using this skill, press or hold <IconNormal /> to chain into the 3rd hit of [Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging].
desc.3: [Crimson Inscription] will not end during this skill.

desc.0: Press <IconEvade /> to activate:
desc.1: A quick dash dodge.
desc.2: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

desc.0: While not in the Crimson Inscription state, press <IconNormal /> during a Dodge to activate:
desc.1: Perform a forward hammer strike, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.

desc.0: Press <IconNormal /> during a <ct color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</ct> to activate:
desc.1: Use the hammer handle to deliver a powerful forward counterattack, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: Character is invulnerable while using this skill

DodgeCounterBloodbloomOathReturningEdge.name: Dodge Counter: Bloodbloom Oath - Returning Edge

desc.0: Press <IconNormal /> during a <ct color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</ct> to activate:
desc.1: Use the Blood Axe to deliver a powerful forward counterattack, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
desc.3: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

desc.0: Press <IconSpecial /> to activate:
desc.1: Launch two bludgeoning attacks forward, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

EXSpecialAttackBloodbloomOathSecretForgi.name: EX Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Secret Forging Techniques

desc.0: With enough Sharpness, and while Claret is not in the Crimson Inscription state, press <IconSpecialReadyEp /> to activate:
desc.1: Transform the forging hammer into the Blood Axe to slash the target enemy, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: After using this skill, Claret enters the Crimson Inscription state for 16s. While off-field, its duration no longer decreases. When Claret defeats an enemy, the duration of Crimson Inscription is extended by 3s. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
desc.3: During this skill, keep holding <IconSpecialReadyEp /> to skip the slash and quickly alt into Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron and Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault.
desc.4: After using this skill, press or hold <IconNormal /> to chain into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging.
desc.5: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

SpecialAttackBloodbloomOathCleavingGoldA.name: Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron

desc.0: While in the Crimson Inscription state, press <IconSpecial /> or <IconSpecialReadyEp /> to activate:
desc.1: Perform a powerful upward slash forward, then follow up with a horizontal Slash, dealing <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: When the horizontal Slash hits an enemy suffering [Gash], inflict [Maim] on the target, dealing additional AoE <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.3: [Crimson Inscription] will not end during this skill.
desc.4: Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill. After successfully triggering [Maim], Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

SpecialAttackBloodbloomOathBloodBurialAs.name: Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault

desc.0: While in the Crimson Inscription state and the upward slash of Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron, keep holding <IconSpecial /> or <IconSpecialReadyEp /> to activate:
desc.1: Perform three consecutive horizontal slashes forward, dealing massive <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>;
desc.2: Each horizontal slash that hits an enemy holding [Gash] triggers [Maim] on the target, dealing additional AoE <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>. Up to 3 consecutive instances of [Maim] can be triggered during this skill, with the 3rd [Maim] having a higher Interrupt Level;
desc.3: Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill;
desc.4: Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill. After successfully triggering [Maim], Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ChainAttackBloodbloomOathResonantBloodPa.name: Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact

desc.0: When a <ct color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</ct> is triggered, select the character to activate:
desc.1: Launch a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease, and the state does not end during this skill.
desc.3: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

UltimateBloodbloomOathTrialAfterTrial.name: Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial

desc.0: When Decibel Rating is at <ct color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</ct>, press <IconUltimateReady /> to activate:
desc.1: Launch a series of slashes against enemies ahead, dealing massive <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>;
desc.2: During this skill, Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease, and the state does not end;
desc.3: Upon activating this skill, restore 10 Sharpness;
desc.4: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

QuickAssistReturnOfTheDireMoon.name: Quick Assist: Return of the Dire Moon

desc.0: When the active character is launched, press <IconSwitch /> to activate:
desc.1: Deals <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

QuickAssistBloodbloomOathReturnOfTheDire.name: Quick Assist Bloodbloom Oath - Return of the Dire Moon

desc.0: When the active character is launched, press <IconSwitch /> to activate:
desc.1: Deals <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
desc.3: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

DefensiveAssistUnyieldingHeartOfTheFurna.name: Defensive Assist: Unyielding Heart of the Furnace

desc.0: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconSwitch /> to activate:
desc.1: Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
desc.2: Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
desc.3: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

AssistFollowUpBloodbloomOathPureforgedEd.name: Assist Follow-Up: Bloodbloom Oath - Pureforged Edge

desc.0: Press <IconNormal /> after a <ct color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</ct> to activate:
desc.1: Deals massive <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: Crimson Inscription will not end during this skill.
desc.3: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

CounterAssistGiveNotAnInchOfSteel.name: Counter Assist: Give Not an Inch of Steel

desc.0: When the character or the on-field character is about to be hit by a Control Skill from certain enemies, press <IconSwitch /> to activate:
desc.1: Engage the enemy in a power struggle. Win the struggle to neutralize the enemy's Control Skill and deal <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>.
desc.2: Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease during this skill.
desc.3: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

AssistFollowUpBloodbloomOathHammerIntoSh.name: Assist Follow-Up: Bloodbloom Oath - Hammer Into Shape

desc.0: After using a <ct color=#FFFFFF>Counter Assist</ct>, press <IconNormal /> to activate:
desc.1: Deals massive <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</ct>. When the heavy attack hits an enemy, it adds one stack of Gash to the target.
desc.2: Crimson Inscription's duration does not decrease during this skill.
desc.3: Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

core.name: Core Passive: Banquet of Pale Blood

desc.0: All DMG dealt by Claret's skills is considered Sharp DMG, and skill DMG Multipliers are based on DEF. Some Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with [Gash], which can stack up to 3 times. When [Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Cleaving Gold and Iron] or [Special Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Blood Burial Assault] hits an enemy inflicted with [Gash], 1 stack of [Gash] is consumed to trigger [Maim] and deal AoE DMG;
desc.1: When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG doesn't receive the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead uses the Laceration DMG Bonus. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration is triggered, the Laceration DMG Bonus is applied an additional time. For every 1% of Claret's initial CRIT DMG, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%;
desc.2: When Claret enters the battlefield, she gains 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s;
desc.3: While Claret is in the Crimson Inscription state, her Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. When Claret uses a [Chain Attack], the duration of [Crimson Inscription] is extended by 2s;
desc.4: While Claret is in [Crimson Inscription], or while using a [Chain Attack], [Ultimate], [Counter Assist], or [Assist Follow-Up], CRIT Rate increases by <ct color=#2BAD00>15%</ct> and Gash Buildup Rate increases by <ct color=#2BAD00>20%</ct>. Triggering a Perfect Dodge during [Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging] or [Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Subduing Axe] increases DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill by 15%.

1.name: Bloodstained Chronicle
1.desc: When Claret's attacks hit enemies and trigger Laceration, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%. The DMG Multiplier of Maim triggered by Claret increases to 130% of its original value.

2.name: Crown of Inherited Flame
2.desc: The maximum duration of [Crimson Inscription] is extended by 2s. While Claret is in the [Crimson Inscription] state, or while using a [Chain Attack], [Ultimate], [Counter Assist], or [Assist Follow-Up], attacks ignore 18% of the target's <ct color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</ct>.

3.name: Oath Written in Frosting
3.desc: <ct color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Assist</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</ct>, and <ct color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</ct> Lv. +2

4.name: Crimson Moon Wanderer
4.desc: During the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging, the time by which the consecutive slashes can be extended is increased. DMG dealt by the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Starforging, Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact, and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial increases by 20%.

5.name: Duskblood Furnace
5.desc: <ct color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Assist</ct>, <ct color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</ct>, and <ct color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</ct> Lv. +2

6.name: Warm Night's Dream
6.desc: When the heavy attacks of Chain Attack: Bloodbloom Oath - Resonant Blood Pact and Ultimate: Bloodbloom Oath - Trial After Trial hit an enemy, Claret directly triggers 1 instance of single-target Maim without consuming Gash.
